title: 부동산에서 방 구하기: 이 방, 가 볼 수 있어요?
objective: You can ask what the rent includes and ask to see a room using -어 보다.
summary: Learn the words and polite questions for finding a room to rent at a Korean real estate office.
setting: A small real estate office (부동산) near a subway station. A customer is looking for a studio to rent and talks with an agent.

task.title: Talk about renting a room
task.line: Use the words and the -어 보다 pattern from page 1 to choose, fill in, and answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: I pay my rent on the 25th of every month.

words.meaning: security deposit (paid at the start, returned later)
words.exampleMeaning: You get the deposit back when you move out.
The maintenance fee is high in winter.
The landlord lives on the second floor.
This neighborhood is quiet and clean.

words.meaning: to be included (in a price or fee)
words.exampleMeaning: Is the electricity bill included in the rent, too?

words.meaning: to try doing something and see; with -도 돼요, it asks for permission to check something
words.exampleMeaning: May I turn on the water to check it?

dialogue.meaning: I'm looking for a studio. With monthly rent.

dialogue.korean: 이 방은 어떠세요? 보증금 500만 원에 월세 50만 원이에요.
dialogue.meaning: How about this room? The deposit is 5 million won, and the monthly rent is 500,000 won.
Do I have to pay the maintenance fee separately?

dialogue.korean: 네, 그런데 인터넷은 관리비에 포함돼 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, but the internet is included in the maintenance fee.

dialogue.korean: 좋네요. 오늘 이 방에 가 볼 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Sounds good. Can I go and see this room today?
Just a moment. I'll call the landlord first and check.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 이 (동네 / 계약)에는 큰 공원이 있어요. ② 방을 구할 때 처음에 큰돈을 내요. 이 돈은 (월세 / 보증금)이에요. ③ 방에 문제가 있으면 (집주인 / 관리비)에게 연락하세요.
Fill in the blank with 열다 + -어 보다: 옷장 문을 ____도 돼요?
Read the dialogue again. Write Yes or No: ① 손님은 월세 방을 찾아요. ② 직원은 손님하고 바로 방에 가요. ③ 관리비는 따로 내야 해요.
Write in Korean: You want to know if the water bill (수도세) is included in the maintenance fee. Ask the agent.
answers: ① 동네 ② 보증금 ③ 집주인
열어 봐 (옷장 문을 열어 봐도 돼요?)
① Yes ② No ③ Yes
수도세가 관리비에 포함돼 있어요? (수도세는 관리비에 포함돼요?)
